title: `dashboard` publishes only columns/gap/className as inputs — `widgets`, `title`, `header`, `globalFilters`, `dateRange`, `refreshInterval` all draw `unknown-prop` while the renderer honours them
body:
Found while implementing the #5709 census (out-of-scope there; recorded, not touched). Same class as the shipped #4668 / #5091 cards: keys the renderer honours that the registration never publishes, so the authoring manifest warns an author off keys that work.

## Measured on `origin/main` at `8689166f6`

The `dashboard` registration (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`, the `ComponentRegistry.register('dashboard', DashboardRenderer, ...)` call) declares exactly three inputs: `columns`, `gap`, `className`. Its `defaultProps` even carries `widgets: []` — but `widgets` is not an input.

`DashboardRenderer` (same package) reads all of these off the schema:

- `schema.widgets` — the entire widget tree (read throughout; e.g. the `schema.widgets ?? []` reads in the layout pass)
- `schema.title` / `schema.label` — header title (spec-canonical `label` per framework#1878)
- `schema.header` — `showTitle` / `showDescription` / `actions[]`
- `schema.globalFilters` — the dashboard filter bar (bound to the spec's `GlobalFilter`, objectui#4032)
- `schema.dateRange` — date-range filter config
- `schema.refreshInterval` — auto-refresh timer
- `schema.description`, `schema.aria` — header description, ARIA attributes

Consequence for an author: `validateTree` over the live manifest reports `unknown-prop` on every one of those keys on an inline `dashboard` node — including `widgets` itself, the key the new #5709 unconsumed-options warning descends into. The two diagnostics side by side read incoherently: the validator disclaims the prop and then reasons about its contents.

`dashboard` is in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` (`packages/core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`), so this is contract surface, serialized into `sdui.manifest.json` and `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts`.

## What this is not

Not a request to blanket-declare everything: #5091 settled that some honoured keys are deliberately non-author surface, per-key, by ruling. The ask is the same per-key triage for the `dashboard` block: declare the authored ones (at minimum `widgets`, which every example in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` authors), and pin the deliberate exclusions the way `gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx` does.
